description: Installation of a heat pump within front garden.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
The development hereby permitted shall be retained and thereafter maintained in complete accordance with the following approved plans:
To ensure the development complies with the provisions of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020), and the London Plan (2021).

Prior to the first operational use of the air source heat pump hereby approved, details of a suitable screening enclosure for the air source heat pump shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall include the design, dimensions, materials, colour and finish of the enclosure.

The approved screening enclosure shall be installed prior to the first operational use of the air source heat pump and shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the air source heat pump.

To minimise the visual impact of the air source heat pump and safeguard the character and appearance of the surrounding Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies DMHB 1 and DMHB 4 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).
All heat pump equipment and associated external apparatus shall be removed from the site within three months of becoming redundant, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that redundant plant and equipment do not detract from the visual amenities of the area or the appearance of the building, in accordance with Policies DMHB 11 and DMHD 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).
